articles.summary: Here at Blend, we recently shifted to a multitenant paradigm for our core application. That is to say we moved from a paradigm where a single instance of our app served traffic from a single customer to one where a single instance can serve any number of them. Why didn’t we start that way? If you have a system where customers need to interact with each other, multitenancy is necessary from the start.
articles.title: Moving to Multitenancy
